scope: 10 fixed-seed full 22x16 warehouse Engine fixtures with 10 physical AGVs, 1-3 initial closures, live route closure/unblock, varied orders/priority/drop points and periodic urgent orders. Controlled online pair requests seed vertex and opposite-edge conflicts before tick execution; all vehicles then move through real Engine ticks with WMS traffic. In-memory SQLite, replay disabled, accelerated simulation. Not arbitrary topology or natural deadlock success probability.
